title: OSPFv3: Graceful Restart (RFC 5187)
description:
- Add support for OSPFv3 Graceful Restart (RFC 5187)
- Use existing function dissect_ospf_lsa_grace_tlv() because TLV format
  is basically shared across OSPFv2 and OSPFv3
- Changes to dissect_ospf_lsa_grace_tlv() to make it OSPF-version-aware
  because OSPFv3 lacks TLV type 3 compared to OSPFv2
- Rename HFs ospf.v2.grace.* to ospf.grace.* because the same HFs
  are used for OSPFv2 and OSPFv3
- Fix lower-/upper-case typos
- Switch grace period from seconds-text to BASE_UNIT_STRING
